flat_integrability: Known theorem applied under compact boundaryless CMC and sufficient regularity hypotheses; Appendix D.
second_order: Explicit finite-order corrections; distinct from the theorem proving local exact-family existence.
curved_reduction: Selected backgrounds and sectors in Appendices F-G; no universal curved physical spectrum.

sol_local_integrability.background: BF-01 on the fixed compact Sol quotient; fixed t0 in [1,2].
sol_local_integrability.data: Real metric and momentum-density variations in H^s x H^(s-1), fixed integer s >= 6, satisfying all linearized vacuum constraints.
sol_local_integrability.conclusion: Tangency to an exact vacuum constraint-data family, local Cauchy development and LC lift to source-free EC with constant complete NY.
sol_local_integrability.basis: Fischer-Marsden-Moncrief (1980), Theorem 2.1, with the function-space and elliptic arguments of SL-01 through SL-05.
sol_local_integrability.modes: Nonzero-base Gowdy reconstruction; E(t0)y for y in D^4 with original tensor phases and conjugate orbit restored; continuous SH-03 Hermite initial profile; infinite sums obeying SL-07.
sol_local_integrability.boundary: Small family parameter and local time. No fixed CMC value, gauge, Gowdy ansatz or single-orbit closure is imposed. Arbitrary reduced L2 data, numerical trajectory certification, SG-05 well-posedness and nonlinear stability are not established.

limitations: Finite-time interior numerical evidence is not a whole-line theorem.
Convergence of the reduced fourth-order system (SG-05) under the Lorenz evolution is not established.
Finite low-label checks are not an all-j or non-LRS classification.
Sol local integrability concerns admissible full initial data, not a closed realization of SG-05 or fixed-sector nonlinear families.
